response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate FROM matched), grouped AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM matched GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune AS order_type, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - o.avg_rebate AS above_overall_avg FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.avg_rebate > o.avg_rebate ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A relative gap is undefined when feerate is zero; those rows are excluded from that average. SQLite AVG also excludes NULL values.
